proposal.reason: Primary change is in proxy/ipc FD-exchange control flow: adds pidfd fallback when UDS send/init fails, new proxy message handling (GetFd/QueryFd/CloseFd), and proxy-side FD/resource cleanup/service-failure behavior in proxy/ipcsocket paths. Additional transport review is needed because P2P transport registration logic in src/transport/p2p.cc now integrates pidfd-imported FD ownership/close behavior for buffer registration.
